import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Identify roadside and general stations
query_stations = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, station_type
FROM air_quality_station
ORDER BY station_type, id
""")
stations_df = pd.read_sql(query_stations, engine)
print("Station types:")
print(stations_df)

# Step 2: Get average NO2 and PM2.5 for roadside and general stations in October 2025
query = text("""
SELECT 
    aqs.station_type,
    AVG(hsaq.no2) as avg_no2,
    AVG(hsaq.pm2_5) as avg_pm25
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.no2 IS NOT NULL
  AND hsaq.pm2_5 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY aqs.station_type
""")
avg_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("\nAverage concentrations by station type:")
print(avg_df)

# Extract values
roadside_no2 = avg_df.loc[avg_df['station_type'] == 'ROADSIDE', 'avg_no2'].values[0]
general_no2 = avg_df.loc[avg_df['station_type'] == 'GENERAL', 'avg_no2'].values[0]
roadside_pm25 = avg_df.loc[avg_df['station_type'] == 'ROADSIDE', 'avg_pm25'].values[0]
general_pm25 = avg_df.loc[avg_df['station_type'] == 'GENERAL', 'avg_pm25'].values[0]

# Compute ratios
no2_roadside_general_ratio = round(roadside_no2 / general_no2, 2)
pm25_roadside_general_ratio = round(roadside_pm25 / general_pm25, 2)

# Determine which pollutant has larger roadside enhancement
if no2_roadside_general_ratio > pm25_roadside_general_ratio:
    more_traffic_dominated = "NO2"
else:
    more_traffic_dominated = "PM2.5"

print(f"Roadside avg NO2: {roadside_no2:.2f}, General avg NO2: {general_no2:.2f}")
print(f"Roadside avg PM2.5: {roadside_pm25:.2f}, General avg PM2.5: {general_pm25:.2f}")
print(f"NO2 roadside/general ratio: {no2_roadside_general_ratio}")
print(f"PM2.5 roadside/general ratio: {pm25_roadside_general_ratio}")
print(f"More traffic-dominated pollutant: {more_traffic_dominated}")

# Step 3: Compute NO2/PM2.5 ratio during rush hours vs off-peak at roadside stations
# Rush hours: 7:00-10:00 and 17:00-20:00 (typical HK peak traffic)
# Off-peak: 22:00-06:00 (late night/early morning low traffic)
query_rush = text("""
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'morning_rush'
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN 'evening_rush'
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 22 AND 23 
          OR EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN 'offpeak'
    END AS period,
    AVG(hsaq.no2) as avg_no2,
    AVG(hsaq.pm2_5) as avg_pm25
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE aqs.station_type = 'ROADSIDE'
  AND hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.no2 IS NOT NULL
  AND hsaq.pm2_5 IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 7 AND 9)
    OR (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 17 AND 19)
    OR (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 22 AND 23)
    OR (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 0 AND 5)
  )
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period
""")
period_df = pd.read_sql(query_rush, engine)
print("\nPeriod analysis at roadside stations:")
print(period_df)

# Compute combined rush hour averages
rush_no2 = period_df.loc[period_df['period'].isin(['morning_rush', 'evening_rush']), 'avg_no2'].mean()
rush_pm25 = period_df.loc[period_df['period'].isin(['morning_rush', 'evening_rush']), 'avg_pm25'].mean()
offpeak_no2 = period_df.loc[period_df['period'] == 'offpeak', 'avg_no2'].values[0]
offpeak_pm25 = period_df.loc[period_df['period'] == 'offpeak', 'avg_pm25'].values[0]

rush_no2_pm25_ratio = round(rush_no2 / rush_pm25, 2)
offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio = round(offpeak_no2 / offpeak_pm25, 2)

print(f"\nRush hour avg NO2: {rush_no2:.2f}, avg PM2.5: {rush_pm25:.2f}")
print(f"Off-peak avg NO2: {offpeak_no2:.2f}, avg PM2.5: {offpeak_pm25:.2f}")
print(f"Rush hour NO2/PM2.5 ratio: {rush_no2_pm25_ratio}")
print(f"Off-peak NO2/PM2.5 ratio: {offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio}")

print(f"no2_roadside_general_ratio = {no2_roadside_general_ratio}")
print(f"pm25_roadside_general_ratio = {pm25_roadside_general_ratio}")
print(f"more_traffic_dominated = '{more_traffic_dominated}'")
print(f"rush_no2_pm25_ratio = {rush_no2_pm25_ratio}")
print(f"offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio = {offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio}")

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Compute NO2/PM2.5 ratio for the specified rush hours (08:00-09:00, 17:00-19:00)
# and off-peak hours (00:00-05:00, 10:00-15:00) at roadside stations in October 2025
query = text("""
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 8 AND 8 THEN 'rush_morning'
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 17 AND 18 THEN 'rush_evening'
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 0 AND 4 THEN 'offpeak_night'
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 10 AND 14 THEN 'offpeak_midday'
    END AS period,
    AVG(hsaq.no2) as avg_no2,
    AVG(hsaq.pm2_5) as avg_pm25
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE aqs.station_type = 'ROADSIDE'
  AND hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.no2 IS NOT NULL
  AND hsaq.pm2_5 IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 8 AND 8)
    OR (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 17 AND 18)
    OR (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 0 AND 4)
    OR (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) BETWEEN 10 AND 14)
  )
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period
""")
period_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("Period breakdown:")
print(period_df)

# Compute combined rush hour and off-peak averages
rush_no2 = period_df.loc[period_df['period'].isin(['rush_morning', 'rush_evening']), 'avg_no2'].mean()
rush_pm25 = period_df.loc[period_df['period'].isin(['rush_morning', 'rush_evening']), 'avg_pm25'].mean()

offpeak_pm25 = period_df.loc[period_df['period'].isin(['offpeak_night', 'offpeak_midday']), 'avg_pm25'].mean()

rush_no2_pm25_ratio = round(rush_no2 / rush_pm25, 2)
offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio = round(offpeak_no2 / offpeak_pm25, 2)

print(f"\nRush hour avg NO2: {rush_no2:.2f}, avg PM2.5: {rush_pm25:.2f}")
print(f"Off-peak avg NO2: {offpeak_no2:.2f}, avg PM2.5: {offpeak_pm25:.2f}")
print(f"Rush hour NO2/PM2.5 ratio: {rush_no2_pm25_ratio}")
print(f"Off-peak NO2/PM2.5 ratio: {offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio}")

print(f"rush_no2_pm25_ratio = {rush_no2_pm25_ratio}")
print(f"offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio = {offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio}")
